summary: Sprint 'Compartir Propiedades (Public URL)' verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass — publicUrl canonical for published (VAR-163159 → .../propiedad/var-163159), null for draft, canonical (no tracking) on /api/public/listings and /api/public/listings/{id}. Frontend: Compartir action for published property copies canonical publicUrl to clipboard, shows toast '✅ Propiedad lista para compartir', does NOT open WhatsApp or any new tab. For draft, menu-share-disabled-{id} is present with correct hint and clicking is a no-op (no toast, no clipboard change).
critical_code_review_comments: inquiries.py is the single source of truth for canonical_url/is_web_published/public_url_or_none — good separation. Reused by serializers.property_to_response and routes_public.
PropertyResponse.public_url (camelCase publicUrl on wire) is Optional[str] with default None — correct nullability contract.
PropertiesScreen.onShare falls back to a textarea + document.execCommand('copy') when navigator.clipboard is unavailable — good compat.
Non-published branch uses <div> with aria-disabled='true' and data-testid menu-share-disabled-{id}; keyboard interaction is fine because it is not a button. OK for scope.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_share_unpub draft property via POST /api/properties during frontend test, deleted via DELETE /api/properties/{id} in the same run. Backend pytest also creates and cleans up its own draft.
